description: Simulate a monthly SIP in one Indian mutual fund scheme using its actual historical NAVs: each instalment buys units at the NAV on its due date (or the next NAV date after a holiday). Returns the number of instalments, total invested, units, current value, absolute gain and XIRR, plus a year-by-year summary. Supports an optional annual step-up. Use for 'what would my SIP be worth' questions. Ignores stamp duty, exit load and tax; can't project future returns.

annual_step_up_pct.description: Optional yearly increase in the SIP amount, in percent (0 = flat SIP)

end_date.description: Valuation date (optional; defaults to the latest NAV date). No instalments after it in YYYY-MM-DD format

monthly_amount.description: Monthly SIP amount in rupees, e.g. 10000

start_date.description: Date of the first instalment; later instalments fall on the same day each month in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: calculate_sip_returns
title: Calculate SIP returns
